other_conditions: The unit must have its operations located in Goa.
The applicant must be a Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership.
Bank accounts of the unit and/or its partners/directors must be linked to Aadhaar.
The unit must have operated from the intended office space for more than two years to qualify for the subsidy.
Employees must have been on the company’s payroll for at least one year to receive the benefit.
For expansion units, new employees must have been on the payroll for at least one year prior to application.
Applications can be submitted on a quarterly, bi‑annual, or annual basis after the relevant expenditure is incurred.
Benefits are subject to the availability of budgetary allocation.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 20% on capital investments (plus an additional 10% for Mega Business Units or key focus areas), with maximum rebates ranging from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore depending on the business size.
